title: Playing with Brownlee, Sharky Bonanno and Tom Brown
summary: Harry lists early work with Norman Brownlee, Johnny Wiggs and Sharky Bonanno, and playing with Tom Brown.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Can you tell us some more about some of the jobs you played? You mentioned a couple of these early jobs with the...
Oh, well, I played with Johnny, Johnny Hyman, I guess, haven't I? Years back with Brown Lee.
I worked with Sharky Bonanno when we were young.
Let's see, was Tom Brown in the... Tom, yeah. In that Brown Lee band?
I played quite a bit with Tom, yeah. With Brown Lee and of course with Johnny, Johnny Ways. And we made some nice recordings.
